source.paraphrase: src/middleware.ts, or src/middleware/index.ts, must export a named onRequest function. It must not be a default export.

invariants.why: Astro does not call the file, so locals, auth, and rewrites never run.
invariants.fixHint: Export onRequest as a function, as export const onRequest = defineMiddleware(...), or re-export that name. sequence() is a value you assign to onRequest.
invariants.avoid: A destructuring export such as export const { onRequest } = handlers is reported. The check reads src/middleware and src/middleware/index only.

source.paraphrase: An endpoint exports a function named for the HTTP method. Astro calls GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS, HEAD, and ALL.

invariants.why: A lowercase export is not a handler, so the route responds as if that method were missing.
invariants.fixHint: Rename the export to the uppercase method. A local helper named get can stay unexported.
invariants.avoid: Files and directories under src/pages whose names start with _ are not routes and are ignored. delete is a reserved word and is not matched as a binding. A non-exported function is not a handler.

source.paraphrase: An action's handler is the function Astro runs on the server. input is optional and validates with Zod when you set it.

invariants.why: An action without a handler has no server function to call.
invariants.fixHint: Add handler: async (input) => ... or the method form async handler(input) {}. Export the action from the server object in src/actions/index.ts.
invariants.avoid: A spread object is not inspected. defineAction outside src/actions/ is not read. Whether the action is also exported from the server object is a cross-file check.
